title.zh: 将 GreatLoveMeta 订阅迁移至 SmartPay5

purpose.en: Bind subscription entitlement to the signed-in member PayerID while allowing any connected wallet to fund the payment, including fee-on-transfer tokens.
purpose.zh: 以登录会员的 PayerID 绑定订阅权益，同时允许任意连接钱包付款，并支持转账扣税代币。

en: Pass the signed-in member RefID as PayerID and the permanent administrator RefID as product owner.
Read payment history by PayerID while retaining the funding wallet only for audit.
Accept fee-on-transfer tokens without recipient balance-delta or amount verification.
zh: 以登录会员 RefID 作为 PayerID，并以永久管理员 RefID 作为产品所有者。
按 PayerID 读取付款记录，付款钱包仅作审计。
不校验收款余额差额或实际到账金额，从而支持转账扣税代币。

en: GreatLoveMeta monthly and annual crypto subscriptions, account payment history, and administrator payment tools.
zh: GreatLoveMeta 月费及年费加密订阅、账户付款记录与管理员支付工具。

en: Publish a fresh site-owned SmartPay5 ABI and deployment path with GreatLoveMeta membership product IDs and empty SecondID.
Claim subscriptions only after a successful confirmed SmartPay5 receipt and derive entitlement time from the clamped chain timestamp.
Allow the funding wallet to differ from or be absent from the member profile, remove wallet uniqueness, normalize PayerID lookup case-insensitively, and pin fflate 0.8.3.
zh: 发布全新本站 SmartPay5 ABI 与部署路径，采用 GreatLoveMeta 会员产品 ID 及空 SecondID。
仅在 SmartPay5 回执成功且确认数充足后更新订阅，并以校正后的链上时间计算权益。
允许付款钱包与会员资料钱包不同或资料中没有钱包，移除钱包唯一限制，PayerID 查询忽略大小写，并锁定 fflate 0.8.3。

en: Compile and execute SmartPay5 contract tests including fee-on-transfer and case-insensitive PayerID coverage, apply every D1 migration to a fresh database, pass lint, build, full repository tests, deployment workflow, and production HTTP probes.
zh: 编译并执行 SmartPay5 合约测试（含转账扣税与 PayerID 大小写无关场景），在全新数据库应用全部 D1 迁移，并通过代码规范、构建、全仓测试、部署流程及生产 HTTP 探测。

en: Realtime browser testing is intentionally omitted at the user's request.
zh: 按用户要求，本次不执行实时浏览器测试。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, header, footer, monthly and annual plans, Clerk, classrooms, RealtimeKit, referrals, R2, and independent infrastructure.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、页头页尾、月费及年费套餐、Clerk、课堂、RealtimeKit、推荐系统、R2 与独立基础设施。
